# KaisySales

> KaisySales is sales, inventory and invoicing software for small businesses
> across Africa. It records daily sales and expenses, tracks stock, sends
> invoices and reports real profit. It is free to use, with every feature
> included and no credit card required.

- Website: https://kaisy-sales.vercel.app/
- Pricing: https://kaisy-sales.vercel.app/pricing (free)
- Help: https://kaisy-sales.vercel.app/pages/help.html
- Privacy: https://kaisy-sales.vercel.app/pages/privacy.html
- Terms: https://kaisy-sales.vercel.app/pages/terms.html
- Support: support@kaisysales.com

## What it does

KaisySales is a web app with two modes, chosen once when a business signs up.
A business uses one mode or the other, never both.

**Retail mode** — for shops and anyone selling physical goods:

- Daily sales, with a running total for the day
- Products and stock levels, with low-stock alerts
- Expenses, including cost of goods
- Invoices for products
- Business overview and reporting
- Staff logins limited to one branch and to the modules the owner grants
- Multiple branches for one business

**Services mode** — for freelancers, agencies and consultants:

- One-time income per client
- Recurring income (monthly, quarterly, yearly) with a next-due date
- Customer records and outstanding balances
- Service expenses, including platform fees taken by marketplaces
- Invoices billed by milestone
- Service reporting and profit totals

## Pricing

Free. There is one plan and it includes every feature. No credit card, no trial
period that expires, no per-user fee, and no charge per branch. If a paid plan is
ever introduced, existing users are told before anything changes.

## Countries and currencies

Built for small businesses across Africa: Ghana, Nigeria, Kenya, South Africa,
Tanzania, Uganda, Cameroon, Sierra Leone, Liberia and The Gambia.

Amounts display in the local currency using ISO codes — GHS, NGN, KES, ZAR, TZS,
UGX, XAF, SLL, LRD and GMD — plus USD and GBP.

## What it is not

Stated plainly so no one signs up expecting it:

- Not an accounting package. There is no general ledger, no double-entry
  bookkeeping and no statutory chart of accounts.
- No tax filing and no certified e-invoicing. Invoices are business documents,
  not fiscal documents recognised by a tax authority.
- No payment processing. A sale records how it was paid (cash, card, mobile
  money) as a label; KaisySales never touches the money and holds no balance.
- No mobile app to download. It runs in a web browser on a phone, tablet or
  computer.
- No offline mode. It needs a connection.

## Data and security

Records are stored in Supabase (PostgreSQL). Row-level security means a signed-in
account can only read its own business's rows, and connections are encrypted in
transit. Every business table is scoped by business, branch and module inside the
database rather than by the screen.
